_readme: S403 SkyYarrow, 2026-10-17. Santiago Canyon's eLumen host serves the 2025-2026 catalog only (S402). Its own site may link the 2026-2027 catalog as a PDF or an archive; the 40-link cap hid them twice, so this read shows PDF links only, from the college's catalog page. One load.
